pages.title: Time Dilation Chamber
pages.text: Holds its samples deep in the gravity well of a dense core, where their clocks run slow against the world outside.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the core's mass and how close to it the samples are held. Their clocks run slow by 1/√(1 − r_s/r): near the horizon, very slow - work done here is done many times over, as seen from outside. Closer than the horizon and they fall in. Taller chambers hold more.

pages.name: Time Dilation Chamber
pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().

$(thing)Machine data$(): a multiblock (16 item and 16 fluid inputs, 4 and 4 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Polonium-210 Source, Strained Spacetime, Tidal Plasma, Tidal Shear Crystal, Time-Dilated Sample.
